therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: T-cell activation and anti-tumor immune response
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Advanced or refractory solid cancers who have progressed with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitor as their most recent therapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Phase 1: Dose-limiting toxicities and pharmacokinetics; Phase 2: Treatment-related adverse events

results.target_engagement_evidence: Dose-proportional pharmacokinetics demonstrated with Cmax ranging from 1.95 to 120 ug/mL and AUC0-21d from 317 to 18803 hour*ug/mL across dose levels
subgroup_findings: Higher doses in Phase 1 showed 0% ORR
safety_signals: No dose-limiting toxicities observed in Phase 1
results.dose_information: Five dose levels tested in Phase 1, 21-day cycles, IV infusion
